test_title: PYST 84: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. H is sitting to the immediate right of C. B sitting third to the left of H. P is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate left of G?
solution: Given: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1) H is sitting to the immediate right of C. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e44b6953eb96029bf1eaf8d86294206345c924251fdea7ee5072ed03acfbff7.png] 2) B sitting third to the left of H.
